ourStory.headerSubtitle: We are the voice of cocoa from Rondônia, a movement that celebrates our origin, protects our legacy, and works towards a future where every bean is synonymous with excellence, respect, and prosperity.

sementeMudanca.title: The Seed of Change
sementeMudanca.imageAlt: Cocoa producers in a planning meeting
sementeMudanca.text1: Our journey began to flourish from the "Cacau Sustentável" (Sustainable Cocoa) project, a visionary initiative in partnership with SEBRAE Rondônia. It was this initial support, combined with accurate diagnostics and the joint effort of producers, that paved the way for the creation of Cacauron.
sementeMudanca.text2: The goal has always been clear: to foster the production chain, guarantee a better quality of life for families in the countryside, and reveal to the world the true identity and potential of cocoa farming in Rondônia. On August 20, 2021, this dream became a reality.

seloExcelencia.title: A Seal of Excellence and Identity
seloExcelencia.imageAlt: Cocoa beans with the Rondônia Cacau seal
seloExcelencia.text1: The heart of our mission is the promotion and protection of the Indication of Provenance "Rondônia Cacau". This is not just a seal, but a certification of heritage. It attests to the origin, superior quality, and authenticity of a cocoa that carries the unique characteristics of our Amazonian terroir.
seloExcelencia.text2: Cacauron is the guardian of this designation, ensuring that every product bearing this mark meets rigorous standards of excellence, reflecting our members' commitment to sustainable practices and the appreciation of local culture.

qualidadeReconhecida.title: A Fruit of Recognized Quality
qualidadeReconhecida.text1: The cocoa from Rondônia is not just promising; it is an award-winning reality. The distinct quality of our beans, a result of careful management and a favorable terroir, has already been celebrated and recognized in important national competitions. This recognition is the engine that drives us to seek even greater heights.
qualidadeReconhecida.text2: We are a pioneering organization in Brazil, the only one to embrace in a single entity the two fundamental links of this chain: the cacauicultores (cocoa farmers), who care for the land, and the chocolateiros (chocolatiers), who transform the fruit into art.

potenciaNacional.title: National Powerhouse
potenciaNacional.text: We already rank as the 4th largest cocoa producer in Brazil.

presencaEstadual.title: Statewide Presence
presencaEstadual.text: Cocoa production is present in at least 90% of our territory.

visaoFuturo.title: Vision for the Future
visaoFuturo.text: We have an ambitious goal to triple our production with a focus on sustainability.

indicacaoGeografica.heroTitle: IG Rondônia: The Seal that Guarantees Origin and Quality
indicacaoGeografica.introTitle: What is the "Rondônia Cacau" Geographical Indication?
indicacaoGeografica.introText1: It is the official recognition of the deep connection between a product of excellence and its place of origin. Granted to cocoa beans (Theobroma cacao) from the entire state, this certification attests to the unique quality and singular characteristics that only the Amazonian terroir of Rondônia can offer.
indicacaoGeografica.introText2: Cacauron, as the official holder of the registration, is proud to manage and protect this heritage, ensuring that every bean bearing the seal represents our history, sustainability, and passion.

terroirAmazonico.title: The Amazonian Terroir: Cradle of a Unique Cocoa
terroirAmazonico.imageAlt: Landscape of a cocoa farm in Rondônia
terroirAmazonico.text1: The cocoa of Rondônia is born in the heart of the Amazon biome, shaped by a combination of natural factors that create a perfect environment for its development. The equatorial climate, with abundant rainfall, an average annual temperature of 26°C, and more than five hours of daily sunlight, is ideal for the cocoa tree.
terroirAmazonico.text2: The plant, native to the Amazon, adapts perfectly to the local soils, whose characteristics are easily balanced with management techniques. Cultivated predominantly by family farmers, our cocoa can be of seedling or clonal origin, or a combination of both, always managed with agroforestry and conservationist practices.

producaoSustentavel.title: Sustainable Production: Respect for the Environment and People
producaoSustentavel.text1: As a native plant, Rondônia's cocoa is a powerful ally for environmental preservation. Its production in Agroforestry Systems (SAFs) is one of the greatest attributes of our activity, aiding in the restoration of Permanent Preservation Areas (APPs) and Legal Reserves.
producaoSustentavel.text2: This cultivation model protects water resources, the landscape, and biodiversity, while also generating income, wealth, and helping families stay on their land, strengthening family farming. This synergy results in an efficient activity with a profound positive impact.

saborDistinto.title: Distinct Flavor
saborDistinto.text: The characteristics of our terroir are reflected in an unmistakable and unique flavor.

qualidadeFisicoQuimica.title: Physical-Chemical Quality
qualidadeFisicoQuimica.text: It presents an ideal fat content and melting point for chocolates of high consistency and complexity.

sinergiaAmazonia.title: Synergy with the Amazon
sinergiaAmazonia.text: Our production goes hand-in-hand with preservation, resulting in an efficient and high-impact activity.

mapa.title: A Seal for the Entire State
mapa.text: The Indication of Provenance "Rondônia Cacau" covers the entire state of Rondônia, including all 52 of its municipalities. This demonstrates a collective and unified commitment from all our producers to the high standards of quality, traceability, and sustainability that the seal represents.
mapa.imageAlt: Map of Rondônia highlighting the 52 municipalities of the Geographical Indication

documentos.title: Sanitary Defense and Traceability
documentos.intro: Protecting the quality of our cocoa is a priority. To prevent the entry of the Monilíase pest in Rondônia, IDARON has established new rules for producer registration and the transit of almonds. Access the official documents for more details.

associadosPage.headerSubtitle: Meet the brands that transform Rondônia's cocoa into art.

cacaulandia.descricao: A pioneering brand from the Barbosa family, producing bean-to-bar chocolate with original recipes, focusing on environmental preservation and also promoting ecotourism.

tiengo.descricao: Tree-to-bar chocolate that unites family tradition and sustainability. Produced artisanally, it is vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free, representing the pure flavor of the Amazon.

shalom.descricao: A family business run by mother and daughter, focused on artisanal production. They create chocolates that are true experiences of affection, art, and well-being.

targa.descricao: Produces chocolates from fine cocoa beans grown on their own farm, without the use of agrochemicals and with a total focus on sustainability.

franco.descricao: Bean-to-bar chocolate factory specializing in zero milk, zero gluten, and no refined sugar options, expressing the identity of Rondônia's cocoa.

santana.descricao: A family business envisioned by a cocoa farmer. Focused on adding value to local cocoa, its main mission is to deliver high-quality products to its customers.

cacauRaiz.descricao: Founded 7 years ago, Cacau Raiz was born from the desire to balance motherhood with professional life. Led by women, our brand goes beyond chocolates: it is a way to respect nature, value the countryside, and promote food inclusion.

artigoIGRondoniaPage.headerTitle: Cacauron and the appreciation of the Geographical Identity of Cocoa from Rondônia
artigoIGRondoniaPage.headerSubtitle: Discover how the Geographical Indication is redefining the quality and recognition of cocoa produced in our state.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.figcaption1: The GI covers all 52 municipalities of the state, unifying production under a quality seal.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.imageAlt1: Map of Rondônia showing the Geographical Indication area
artigoIGRondoniaPage.figcaption2: Cocoa beans from Rondônia: a fruit rich in fat and with the unique flavor of our territory.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.figcaption3: Sustainable cocoa production in Rondônia, integrating cultivation with the Amazonian landscape.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.imageAlt3: Aerial view of a cocoa plantation in Rondônia. The dense, green crop stands out in a sharp rectangle, surrounded by drier pasture areas with native palm trees and the Amazon rainforest in the background.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo1: Cocoa produced in Rondônia is synonymous with quality. The cocoa sector is in constant expansion in the state, supported by a major association that brings together cocoa growers and chocolatiers for the benefit of the industry and its producers. Drawing increasing national attention, whether through the consumer market or quality contests, the excellence of cocoa and chocolate production is based on the protection of its regional identity, which has its own seal proving its exceptional origin.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo2: CACAURON (Associação de Cacauicultores e Chocolateiros de Rondônia), founded on August 20, 2021, was created with the goal of uniting cocoa growers and chocolatiers in a single association — being the only one in the country to encompass both spheres of cocoa production. Raising the banner of sustainable production and supporting research and study, CACAURON aims to protect and promote the geographical identity of cocoa from Rondônia; preserving cultural aspects of the region while striving to elevate the level of product excellence even further. CACAURON acts as the representative of the cocoa sector before federal, state, and municipal governments, working to give the industry proper visibility and defending it when necessary.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo3: On November 14, 2023, at the request of CACAURON, the state of Rondônia was granted, by the Instituto Nacional da Propriedade Industrial (INPI), the Geographical Indication registration in the category Indication of Origin for the product “Cacau em amêndoas – Theobroma cacao”, with a geographic delimitation covering all municipalities of the state. The certification resulted from several technical visits conducted in previous years to confirm the unique quality of cocoa from Rondônia.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo4: According to SEBRAE, the Geographical Indication title (also known as GI) identifies the geographical origin of a product’s production, distinguishing it from others on the market, since a certain origin may indicate unique characteristics found only in products from that region. In the case of cocoa from Rondônia, its particularities come from its adaptation to the Amazon biome, which offers the perfect combination of climate, relief, and soil — creating a fruit rich in fats and ideal for producing chocolates with unique textures and diverse consistencies; a distinct flavor already recognized nationally through competitions.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo5: As the holder of the title IG “Rondônia Cacau”, CACAURON works to ensure the excellence of cocoa quality in the state. To receive the GI seal of origin, producers must meet specific quality requirements consistent with the standards verified by INPI when granting the registration. By managing and protecting the denomination, CACAURON ensures the state’s commitment to the market, always delivering excellence in both cocoa and chocolate production.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo6: Currently, Rondônia is the 4th largest cocoa-producing state in the country, aiming to triple its production in the coming years according to the Strategic Plan for the Cocoa Production Chain being developed with support from SEBRAE and state government agencies. With this support, CACAURON promotes initiatives focused on sustainable production, bringing unique opportunities to cocoa producers. This fosters growth in the sector without endangering the environment or local farming culture, as the goal is to reconcile development with regional identity; creating a unique culture that both exports and produces for Rondônia’s domestic market while fighting for the preservation of the Amazon biome.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo7: On the national stage, producers from the state have gained recognition over the past few years in quality and sustainability contests, reaching a peak in 2023 when, at the Concurso Nacional de Cacau Especial do Brasil, two producers brought pride to the state: Robson Tomaz de Castro, who won first place in the Blend category, and Deoclides Pires da Silva, who won first place in the Varietal category (notably, this same producer had also won first place in 2022 in the same category). In 2024, producer Mauro Celso Tauffer achieved 3rd and 2nd place in the contest in the Varietal and Blend categories, respectively.
artigoIGRondoniaPage.paragrafo8: On December 6, 2025, the 7th edition of the Concurso Nacional de Cacau Especial do Brasil will take place, hosted by the municipality of Cacoal. With Rondônia leading all states in the total number of samples submitted, the announcement of the finalists featured five producers from Rondônia nominated in both contest categories (three in Varietal and two in Blend). As in previous years, Rondônia promises once again to be present on the winners' podium, showcasing the unstoppable growth, good management, and development of this thriving sector for the people of Rondônia.

artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.titulo: Rondônia Shines on the National Scene: Check Out the Winners of the VII National Fine Cocoa Contest
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.subtitulo: The event held at Cacoal Selva Park brought together more than 500 people and honored producers from Rondônia and Pará.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.imageAlt: Large rustic event hall at night, filled with guests seated at round dinner tables.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.figcaption: Audience and guests gathered during the celebration of the National Fine Cocoa Contest.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.p1: This past Saturday (06), the state of Rondônia reaffirmed its leading role in Brazilian cocoa farming by hosting the VII National Fine Cocoa Contest: Sustainability and Quality. The event, already a reference on the agribusiness calendar, transformed Cacoal Selva Park into a stage of excellence, bringing together producers, specialists, and authorities from the sector.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.p2: The ceremony began at 6:30 PM and welcomed an impressive audience of more than 500 people. The program was designed to celebrate the entire production chain, uniting technical knowledge and cultural appreciation. The audience enjoyed lectures on the sector's development, followed by a gala dinner.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.p3: Rondonian culture was highlighted through a vibrant artistic performance by the group Gavião, from Ji-Paraná, bringing local identity to center stage before the most anticipated moment of the night: the revelation of the best cocoas in Brazil.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.p4: The competition was fierce among the 20 finalists, evenly divided between categories. The final results showcased the strength of production in the Northern Region, with producers from Rondônia and Pará dominating the podium.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.p5: In the Varietal category, the major highlight was the Rondonian producer Mauro Celso Tauffer, from Buritis, who secured 1st place with the BN34 variety, reaffirming the genetic quality and excellence in management practiced in the state.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.p6: The success of the VII National Fine Cocoa Contest is the result of the organization by the Centro de Inovação do Cacau (CIC), in strategic co-organization with the Governo do Estado de Rondônia. The partnership ensured that the event not only exceeded audience expectations but also maintained the high technical level and prestige the competition holds nationwide.
artigoConcursoNacionalCacau.p7: To close the night on a high note, the event featured a performance by singer Samara Ayane, celebrating the integration among producers and the strengthening of sustainable cocoa farming in Brazil.

concursoNacional.descricao: Celebrating national production and sustainability, the final of the VII National Fine Cocoa Contest honors the quality of Brazilian cocoa, highlighting the strength of cocoa farming in Rondônia. By participating in this event, Cacauron reinforces its commitment to promoting and valuing the region’s cocoa growers and chocolatiers.

concacau.titulo: Quality and Sustainability Contest of Cacau from Rondônia (Concacau)
concacau.descricao: This event is part of a set of initiatives aimed at developing cocoa farming in the state, promoting both product quality and sustainable production. ConCacau also seeks participation in national events such as the National Fine Cocoa Contest, where producers from Rondônia have achieved outstanding results.
